data_description.off_scene: Optional. If omitted, the sequencer cycles only through on scenes.
data_description.timeout: Required only when off scene is set. Time in seconds before the next call goes to off scene.
data_description.cycle_to_off: When enabled, cycling past the last on scene (or after timeout) will activate the off scene. When disabled, cycle always wraps through on scenes and only scene_off / scene_on_off can activate the off scene.
